steps.code:
# Now move each file to the new structure: <file_name>/<date>.<extension>
for f in files:
    # Extract filename from full path
    filename = f.rsplit('/', 1)[-1]
    # Split by "__" to get date and rest
    date_part, rest = filename.split("__", 1)
    # Split rest by last dot to get file_name and extension
    file_name, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
    # Construct destination path
    dest = base_dir + file_name + "/" + date_part + "." + ext
    print(f"Moving: {f} -> {dest}")
    result = apis.file_system.move_file(source_file_path=f, destination_file_path=dest, access_token=fs_token)
    print(result)
